item.title: On Point with 2019 Spike Cello Festival | Dublin Buzz
item.description: SPIKE 2019, the Dublin Alternative Cello Festival, takes place this February with three days of Cello Action, Concerts, Workshops, and Yoga Cello!

item.title: Gluck's Orfeo ed Euridice on Tour this February | Dublin Buzz
item.description: Irish National Opera begins 2019 with its most extensive tour yet, with 13 performances of Gluck’s Orfeo ed Euridice in 11 venues this February and March.

item.description: The 17th Virgin Media Dublin International Film Festival returns to Dublin on the 20th February with an extraordinary red carpet line-up of local and international on-screen talent and filmmakers.

item.title: Experience Extraordinary Dance at 2019 Dublin Dance Festival | Dublin Buzz
item.description: Dublin Dance Festival is celebrating its 15th edition in 2019. Since its beginnings in 2002 the Festival has been bringing artists and audiences together to share exceptional, provocative and relevant dance

item.title: Irish National Opera, Vivaldi and Griselda | Dublin Buzz
item.description: Next October Irish National Opera will present the first ever Irish performance of any of the operas written by one of the world’s best-loved composers, Antonio Vivaldi.

item.description: Live Collision International Festival, Ireland’s leading live art festival, promises an exceptional programme this April in the Project Arts Centre

item.description: You've watched the film, heard the album and gone to all those screenings. Now Playback bring you a live re-enactment of Talking Heads' Stop Making Sense.
